relations.text: 2025年10月、Westinghouseの原子炉建設を加速する米政府との戦略提携をCamecoと結んだ
relations.text_en: In October 2025, joined Cameco in a strategic partnership with the US Government to speed Westinghouse reactor deployment

source.label: Cameco 年次情報書(2025年度、40-F添付)
source.label_en: Cameco Annual Information Form (FY2025, Form 40-F exhibit)
source.quote: In October, Cameco and Brookfield announced a strategic partnership with the US Government to accelerate deployment of Westinghouse nuclear reactors.

source.note_en: Contingent on a final investment decision and definitive agreements.
